question: What exactly conflicts when two verify.ps1 runs go at once from different worktrees with no -TemporaryRoot, and is it really a race between the two runs?

environment.ambientTempBeforeAnyOverride: powershell -NoProfile -Command "[IO.Path]::GetTempPath()" -> C:\WINDOWS\TEMP\ (both $env:TEMP and $env:TMP already resolved to C:\WINDOWS\TEMP for this session before any verify.ps1 run)

method: Added a throwaway worktree sibling to the claimed one so two independent, real worktrees could run verify.ps1 at the same time without touching another agent's active worktree: 'git worktree add --detach ../_wt-302-repro-b bd5f1ea' from C:/gamedev/_wt-302.

Launched 'powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify.ps1 -Stage scripts,build' with no -TemporaryRoot from C:/gamedev/_wt-302 and from C:/gamedev/_wt-302-repro-b at the same time (two background processes started in the same message, both against the pre-fix scripts/TemporaryRoot.ps1), each redirecting stdout+stderr to its own log.

Once both preflights refused, ran the same two-worktree pair a second time but with only ONE of the two processes running (no concurrency at all), to check whether the failure needs a second agent running at the same time or reproduces from a single run alone: 'powershell -NoProfile -Command New-Item -ItemType Directory ...; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop' against a hand-created C:\WINDOWS\TEMP\probe-manual-test directory, no verify.ps1 involved at all.

Measured whether the account can create-and-delete in two other candidate roots (the normal per-user temp directory, and the worktree's own .artifacts folder), to establish that the account itself is not broadly locked out of temporary-directory deletion - only this one machine-wide directory.

singleRunControl.why: If the failure is genuinely two agents racing for the same subpath, a single run with nobody else active should succeed. It does not, which is the actual finding.
singleRunControl.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p='C:\WINDOWS\TEMP\probe-manual-test'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $p | Out-Null; 'x' | Out-File (Join-Path $p 'a.txt'); Remove-Item -LiteralPath $p -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop"
singleRunControl.result: DELETE FAILED: Атказано в доступе ("Access denied", cp866-decoded) - reproduces with zero concurrency, zero other agents, one process, one directory nobody else ever touched.

accountIsNotBroadlyLockedOut.why: Establishes this is specific to C:\WINDOWS\TEMP, not a general inability of the account to create-and-delete temporary directories anywhere - otherwise the fix in this Issue would be pointless.
accountIsNotBroadlyLockedOut.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "foreach ($p in @('C:\Users\User\AppData\Local\Temp','C:\gamedev\_wt-302\.artifacts')) { $t = Join-Path $p ('probe-' + [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $t | Out-Null; 'x' | Out-File (Join-Path $t 'a.txt'); Remove-Item -LiteralPath $t -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ($p + ': OK') }"

priorPrHandWorkarounds.why: Cross-checks the measured cause against what actually happened in the five PRs the Issue cites, read from their own PR bodies via 'gh pr view <n> --json body'.
priorPrHandWorkarounds.finding: All five (PR #290 twice, #291, #297, #298, #299) describe the identical symptom independently - a preflight refusal on C:\WINDOWS\TEMP with 'could not delete probe directory' - and each agent worked around it by hand-picking a one-off -TemporaryRoot on its own retry (C:\gvtmp283, C:/gamedev/_wt-287-tmp, C:\gamedev\_tmp-282, C:\gamedev\_tmp-282-full). None of the five PR bodies show two agents disputing the same literal subpath; each is a single run failing against the same broken default, independently, and reading its own retry as evidence of contention with whichever other agents happened to be active on the machine at the time.

conclusion: The failure is not a race for a shared subpath between two concurrent runs. It is that this account can create directories under C:\WINDOWS\TEMP but cannot delete from them (the exact Issue #89 failure mode), and that is deterministic and observable from a single run with no other agent active. Every default run without -TemporaryRoot hits it, independently. Two concurrent agents make the practical cost worse only in the sense that both burn the same 7-8 minute retry cycle at the same time, not because they collide with each other's files: measured, the Godot runtime profile subdirectory each run creates under TEMP is already worktree-specific (Get-StablePathHash of the repository root), and the sprite-import project and the probe directory itself are GUID-named per run, so no two runs from different worktrees would ever compute the same path even before this Issue's fix. The correct fix is therefore what the Issue scope already says: stop trusting the machine's ambient TMP/TEMP for the default at all, not add locking or path randomisation to avoid a race that measurement shows does not exist.
